So compression is a must, even to the decimation of quality.</div><div><br></div><div>Due to how project uploading works on Scratch, we can only upload assets 10Mb or smaller at a time. There is no stated hard limit to how big a project could be, though.<br><br>Videos should be no larger than 250mb, so as not to kill the system running it.</div><div><br></div><div>The system should be able to compile a project into the following:<br>- Audio split by the minute</div><div>- Fit as many "virtual" frames into a square-ish grid in a 2048x2048 single costume</div><div>- Vector frames split into folders by 10 MB (Scratch's max update limit)</div><div>- Generate a project.json with the player preconfigured with sound, and the only work that the user has to do is upload the frames<br><br>We will worry about project generation later.</div><div><br></div><div>Libaries are TBD<br><br>Logging should be added.</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="420" width="420" x="10" div.p: A Scratch Video player that utilize's Scratch's ability to embed small jpegs into a vector "frame".

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 418px; height: 1px; padding-top: 157px; margin-left: 2px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; max-height: 416px; overflow: hidden; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.div: This engine is to be built for long-form video (10+ minutes). So compression is a must, even to the decimation of quality.

Due to how project uploading works on Scratch, we can only upload assets 10Mb or smaller at a time. There is no stated hard limit to how big a project could be, though.
Videos should be no larger than 250mb, so as not to kill the system running it.

The system should be able to compile a project into the following:
- Audio split by the minute
- Fit as many "virtual" frames into a square-ish grid in a 2048x2048 single costume
- Vector frames split into folders by 10 MB (Scratch's max update limit)

- Generate a project.json with the player preconfigured with sound, and the only work that the user has to do is upload the frames
We will worry about project generation later.

Libaries are TBD
Logging should be added.
